newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Tuesday closed up by 0.39 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 605.07 from 602.67 on Monday.
Trade volume was 1.83 million dinars ($1.89 million) against 4.43 million dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 1.19 dinar to 40.54 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole gained 0.95 dinar to 32.85 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
